title: SCI.DY.------UNF.PI.
description: Second diagram on page 258 (PR.S(RD)II-12), paired with EXT-DY × SOC-RT-DY above. The crossing diagrams how scientific-dynamics structurally meets unification (positively intended) at the journalism-criticism-of-affinity-interpretation scale the surrounding prose names ('A given observation would find journalists measuring how a particular person functioned with respect to the affinity interpretation that western culture has developed in its own methodology'). SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) crossed with UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). SCI-DY sits on the left with the subject-arrow; TR (transformation) at upper-center and WO-UNF (world-unification) branching from it, with MT-INFO (multi-information), BIA (bi-aitional), and C-RH (composite research) anchoring the right margin as upper outputs of the branch to BIA. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) at center-left below SCI-DY. PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental) below SPT-DY and EXB-H-OR (establishing high order) at lower-left form the subject-side downward chain. EXT-FT (extended functionalism) at right-center branches from the BIA line. UNF-PI sits centrally at lower-center as partner-axis. PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) at the bottom-right as EXT-FT's downward terminus. Structural argument: when scientific-dynamics is crossed with unification (positively intended), TR → WO-UNF branches upward from the main line, and the chain SCI-DY → BIA → EXT-FT → C-RH routes scientific-dynamics through bi-aitional and extended-functionalism into composite-research, with BIA also opening into MT-INFO. The chain passes through bi-aitional at exactly the position where journalism's measurement of affinity-interpretation operates — composite-research gets received through bi-aitional. SPT-DY hangs below SCI-DY as the subject's downward output. SPT-DY → PER-VT-U-FUND → EXB-H-OR is the subject-side downward chain — spiritual dynamics routes through perceived vibrational universe fundamental into establishing-high-order. BIA → EXT-FT → PER-PHY-U-FUND is the right-hand downward chain. The form's affinity-interpretation is journalistically measured against composite-research as received through bi-aitional, not against the form's working scientific-dynamics.
